name: muiltchat-monorepo
description: Cross-session context query and conversation system for AI coding assistants (monorepo root)

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/server && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.build:desktop: npm run build && npm run build -w apps/desktop
scripts.package:desktop: npm run build:desktop && electron-builder --projectDir apps/desktop --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.package:desktop:dir: npm run build:desktop && electron-builder --projectDir apps/desktop --config electron-builder.yml --dir
scripts.ci:test: npm test -w apps/server && npm run test:desktop && node --test scripts/release-config.test.cjs
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run serve -w apps/server" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run serve
